editorial.blurb: VinTea serves authentic, affordable Vietnamese fare with standout drinks and a warmth that keeps regulars coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the vermicelli bowl with grilled pork and egg roll—locals swear by the magic of its layers (crispy veg, pickled daikon, soft noodles, tangy-sweet sauce). The sugarcane juice is a rare find in Chicago.
signatureDishes: Vermicelli bowl with grilled pork and egg roll
